description: Choose a data tool when the subject or supported scope is unknown. Call with no arguments to get a static theme directory with English/French labels, geographic and time coverage, HTTP directory paths and MCP data-tool names. Example: annual country comparisons route to get_historical_indicators. If the tool and inputs are known, call it directly; use domain-specific list_* tools only for missing identifiers or available periods. Use catalog for service policies/counts and list_sources for publishers/licenses. This directory contains no observations or live availability check; inspect data response freshness. No independent factual verification claimed.
